svg.aria-label: Form Coach analysing a real 15-rep push-up set: skeleton at the bottom of a rep, a scoreboard of all 15 reps with 3 flagged, and elbow, hip and simulated chest-strap traces

svg.text: Film a push-up set from the side. Every rep gets measured, then you get the two fixes that matter most.
